title: CBAMValid Self-Service Software Answer Feed
description: Product, workflow, calculation and methodology answers for CBAMValid self-service B2B software.

items.title: What is CBAMValid?
items.content_text: CBAMValid is privately operated self-service B2B software for customer-entered emissions data, deterministic calculations, automated quality controls and automated PDF, JSON and XLSX delivery.

items.title: What does USD 449 buy?
items.content_text: USD 449 purchases one Working File Software Unlock covering one operator, one installation and one reporting year. Drafting is free before lock, and same-file correction re-locks are included.

items.title: When is the card charged?
items.content_text: The card is charged once when the customer chooses to lock a specific working file. Failed locks charge nothing and re-download is free.

items.title: What is delivered after a successful lock?
items.content_text: The application automatically generates downloadable PDF, JSON and XLSX files from the customer-controlled working file.

items.title: Who enters and controls the data?
items.content_text: The customer enters, maintains and controls installation, production, emissions and evidence data inside the software workspace.

items.title: How do the calculations work?
items.content_text: Authoritative calculations run server-side against a named, versioned ruleset. Missing material inputs remain visible and can block a successful lock instead of being converted silently to zero.

items.title: Can one software unlock cover another factory or reporting year?
items.content_text: No. Each paid unlock is bound to one working file. Another installation, reporting year or separate working file requires another payment.

items.title: Can the software be evaluated before payment?
items.content_text: Yes. Customers can create and edit drafts, run automated quality controls and review data gaps before choosing to pay for lock-and-download.
